stories.headline: Houthi strikes kill 13 at Riyadh airport; Trump weighs joining Saudi offensive in Yemen

key_facts.fact: A Houthi missile struck a passenger terminal at Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport on Saturday, October 10, killing 13 people, including a U.S. citizen, and wounding more than 300.
key_facts.excerpt: Then, on Saturday, a Houthi missile struck a passenger terminal at Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport. It killed 13 people, an American among them, and wounded more than 300

key_facts.fact: Asked whether the U.S. would join Saudi strikes against the Houthis, Trump said: "We may. We're going to look at it... We move very quickly."
key_facts.excerpt: "We may. We're going to look at it," Trump told reporters outside the White House on Saturday when asked if the U.S. would back Saudi Arabian strikes. "We just found out about the recent attack. So, we'll make a decision. We move very quickly."

key_facts.fact: Trump had twice in September turned down Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's requests to bomb the Houthis, giving Riyadh intelligence and targeting data instead.
key_facts.excerpt: Twice last month, President Donald Trump had turned down his Saudi friend and ally Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's pleas to bomb Yemen's Houthis... In September, when MBS came calling, Trump gave Riyadh intelligence and targeting data instead of bombs.

key_facts.fact: On October 12 a Houthi official threatened a "swift and painful" response against the U.S. and its regional interests if Washington joins, and warned workers at Saudi oil facilities and airports that those sites are 'legitimate targets'; the Riyadh airport remained closed, with 20 killed in a week of Houthi attacks on it.
key_facts.excerpt: "If the U.S. becomes involved in the aggression against Yemen, we will not deliberate over the decision to respond, rather, there will be a swift and painful response targeting the U.S. and all its interests in the region," ... He also warned "all employees and workers at Saudi oil facilities and airports (should) stay away from these sites, as they have become legitimate targets".

key_facts.fact: Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman said the kingdom would mount an "equally serious" response to the attacks.
key_facts.excerpt: "Energy security can't be taken for granted," Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman told an energy conference in Riyadh. "The events of recent weeks are serious, our response must be equally serious."

key_facts.fact: Brent crude settled up $1.93 (1.8%) at $106.65 on October 12, its highest close since September 15, while the S&P 500 energy sector posted a record close; Goldman Sachs raised its December Brent forecast to $90 from $85, citing a risk premium of just over $20 a barrel.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent crude futures settled up $1.93, or 1.8%, at $106.65 a barrel, their highest close since Sept. 15... Goldman Sachs raised its December Brent forecast to $90 a barrel from $85. The bank estimated that prices carry a risk premium of just over $20 a barrel.

key_facts.fact: Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei said the US-assisted shuttle system moving Gulf crude out past the Strait of Hormuz is an explicit target, and threatened US-linked cables, data centers and AI facilities in the UAE.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei responded on Sunday night, saying the shuttle system is now an explicit target for Tehran... Rezaei threatened US-linked cables, data centres and artificial intelligence facilities in the UAE and around the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.headline: Trump declares Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire' after diesel deal; Russia hits power plants hours later

key_facts.fact: On Friday, October 9, Trump struck a deal with Putin to buy Russian diesel to address high fuel prices before the U.S. midterms; Russia would supply more than 300,000 tonnes initially, 500,000 tonnes in November and 1 million tonnes per period thereafter, under a temporary U.S. Treasury sanctions exemption.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump announced Oct. 9 that Russia would supply 300,000+ tonnes of diesel initially, then 500,000 tonnes in November and 1 million tonnes thereafter... Treasury issued a temporary sanctions exemption for Russian diesel transactions; Moscow eased export curbs Oct. 10.

key_facts.fact: On Sunday, October 11, Trump posted on Truth Social: "Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!" Zelensky said the deal was "news to me."
key_facts.excerpt: Donald Trump has announced an energy ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia, apparently without consulting with Volodymyr Zelenskyy who said the deal to stop long-range attacks was "news to me".

key_facts.fact: Russia struck Kharkiv's CHP-5 power plant after the announcement, and a subsequent missile strike on a grocery store near Kharkiv killed three people and injured at least 22.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia struck Kharkiv's CHP-5 power plant on Oct. 11... Following the strike on the power plant, a Russian missile strike hit a grocery store in the suburbs of Kharkiv, killing three people and injuring at least 22, including two children

key_facts.fact: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said on Monday, October 12, that Zelensky does not "deserve a respite"; Zelensky said Russia hit six Ukrainian energy facilities that day, injuring 33 people, as the EU adopted nearly 1,600 new sanctions against Russia's military-industrial complex.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov told reporters on Monday that he does not believe Zelensky "deserves a respite"... Russia has attacked six energy facilities in Ukraine today... The attacks have injured 33 people... The EU member states have adopted nearly 1,600 new sanctions targeting Russia's military-industrial complex.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said Ukraine could hold elections if Russia agreed to a total 60-day ceasefire.
key_facts.excerpt: "Give us two months, 60 days off. Total ceasefire, 60 days, and we will organize elections," he said

key_facts.fact: A Russian guided-bomb strike on a residential area of Zaporizhzhia on October 10 killed 23 people, including four children.
key_facts.excerpt: Zelenskyy said 23 people were killed in the attack, including four children. More than 30 people were wounded

key_facts.fact: A Ukrainian drone attack on October 11 halted Yandex's data center in Vladimir, the third strike on the company's facilities in four days, disrupting taxi and banking services in dozens of Russian cities and in Kazakhstan, Belarus and Armenia.
key_facts.excerpt: a drone attack on Sunday shutting down a data center in the city of Vladimir, east of Moscow, run by technology giant Yandex. It was the third strike on the company's facilities in four days... leaving users in dozens of Russian cities and in Kazakhstan, Belarus and Armenia unable to order taxis or access banking services

stories.headline: IMF lifts 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1% as AI investment offsets war energy shock

key_facts.fact: The IMF's October 2026 World Economic Outlook, released October 13 at the annual meetings in Bangkok, projects 3.1% global growth in 2026, up from 3.0% in July and below 2025's 3.5%; 2027 is forecast at 3.4%.
key_facts.excerpt: The IMF says it expects the global economy to grow at a 3.1% pace this year. That's up from its July forecast for 3.0% growth and well below the 3.5% expansion in 2025. Growth in 2027 should rebound to 3.4%

key_facts.fact: The upgrade is largely due to AI infrastructure investment, with upgrades for countries supplying AI hardware, including South Korea, Malaysia, Mexico and Thailand.
key_facts.excerpt: The slight improvement is largely due to continued strong investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure, prompting growth upgrades for key advanced economies building AI platforms and especially for countries supplying AI hardware, including South Korea, Malaysia, Mexico and Thailand

key_facts.fact: The IMF projects global headline inflation rising to 4.7% in 2026 before easing to 4.1% in 2027, driven mainly by energy and food prices.
key_facts.excerpt: Global headline inflation is projected to increase to 4.7 percent in 2026 before easing to 4.1 percent in 2027, marking a cumulative upward revision of 0.7 percentage point with the temporary increase driven mainly by energy and food prices.

key_facts.fact: The report warns that a reassessment of AI profitability and productivity could sharply reduce investment and trigger equity market corrections, and that risks are skewed to the downside.
key_facts.excerpt: Risks are skewed to the downside... A reassessment of AI-related profitability and productivity prospects could sharply reduce investment, trigger equity market corrections, and tighten financial conditions

key_facts.fact: The IMF forecasts eurozone growth of 1.1% in 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: high energy prices linked to conflicts will weigh on growth, with eurozone expansion forecast at 1.1%.

stories.headline: Kospi drops over 6% as chip sell-off deepens after Broadcom CEO likens AI investors to gamblers

key_facts.fact: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said on October 12 at a conference in Singapore that many AI investors resemble casino gamblers: "A lot of investors have no clue what they are investing in."
key_facts.excerpt: "A lot of investors have no clue what they are investing in," Tan said, adding that they set very extreme expectations, only to find out that it is almost like they are in a casino.

key_facts.fact: On October 13 South Korea's Kospi fell 6.25%, Samsung Electronics dropped 7.4% and SK Hynix 10%; Japan's Nikkei fell 1.8% and Taiwan's exchange and TSMC lost about 2%.
key_facts.excerpt: South Korea's benchmark Kospi index tumbled 6.25% as investors dumped chip stocks... Samsung Electronics shares dropped 7.4% on the South Korean exchange, while the memory chip maker SK Hynix was down 10%.

key_facts.fact: A second driver was Chinese memory maker CXMT's claim of progress on a new DRAM chip architecture also being developed by Samsung and SK Hynix.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares in semiconductor companies fell on Tuesday after the boss of Broadcom compared many AI investors to "casino" gamblers, and Chinese memory chip maker CXMT said it had made good progress on a new chip architecture.

key_facts.fact: On Monday, October 12, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 2.7% and Micron nearly 4%; Samsung and SK Hynix have dropped about 15% over five trading days.
key_facts.excerpt: Both stocks have now dropped about 15% over the past five trading days... Micron Technology fell nearly 4% overnight, and the Philadelphia Stock Exchange Semiconductor Index dropped 2.7%.

stories.headline: Bumble agrees to $1.3 billion take-private by Ithaca Holdings at 138% premium

key_facts.fact: Bumble announced on October 13 a definitive agreement to be acquired by Ithaca Holdings in an all-cash deal valuing the dating-app company at $1.3 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Bumble Inc. (NASDAQ: BMBL) today announced that it entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Ithaca Holdings ("Ithaca") in an all-cash transaction valuing the Company at $1.3 billion.

key_facts.fact: Shareholders will receive $6.05 per share in cash, about a 138% premium to the unaffected October 9 close and 119% to the 30-day VWAP.
key_facts.excerpt: Bumble common shareholders will receive cash consideration of $6.05 per share of Class A Common Stock, representing an approximately 138% premium to the unaffected closing share price on October 9, 2026, and a premium of approximately 119% to the 30-day volume weighted average price

key_facts.fact: Ithaca co-CEOs Ravi Gupta and John Hegeman will become Bumble's co-CEOs and partner with founder Whitney Wolfe Herd; Ithaca describes its mission as applying frontier technology to renew businesses in a world transformed by AI.
key_facts.excerpt: Ithaca's mission is to apply frontier technology to renew and accelerate businesses that enrich people's lives and create lasting value in a world transformed by AI. Upon closing the transaction, Ithaca Co-CEOs, Ravi Gupta and John Hegeman, will become Co-CEOs of Bumble.

key_facts.fact: Affiliates of Blackstone and Wolfe Herd approved the deal by written shareholder consent; the merger agreement was signed October 12.
key_facts.excerpt: On October 12, 2026, Bumble Inc. entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Ithaca Holdco, Inc.... Principal Stockholders delivered a written consent adopting the merger agreement.

key_facts.fact: TechCrunch notes the deal comes after years of declining subscriber numbers and falling revenue at Bumble.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal would take the company private after years of declining subscriber numbers, falling revenue, and mounting pressure to rethink the online dating experience.

stories.headline: FDA approves Hovilpri, first HSV drug with a new mechanism in nearly 30 years

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Hovilpri (pritelivir) on October 9, 2026, its 46th novel drug approval of the year, for immunocompromised adults with mucocutaneous herpes simplex lesions that have not responded to other therapies.
key_facts.excerpt: 46. | Hovilpri | pritelivir | 10/9/2026 | To treat adults with weakened immune systems who have mucocutaneous lesions caused by herpes simplex virus infection and have not responded to other therapies

key_facts.fact: Asahi Kasei says the oral helicase-primase inhibitor is the first FDA-approved HSV therapy with a novel mechanism of action in nearly 30 years; it was developed by AiCuris, now part of Asahi Kasei Therapeutics.
key_facts.excerpt: HOVILPRI (pritelivir), a novel oral helicase-primase inhibitor represents the first FDA approved HSV therapy with a novel mechanism of action in nearly 30 years... developed by AiCuris Anti-infective Cures AG, which is now a part of Asahi Kasei Therapeutics.

key_facts.fact: In the Phase 3 PRIOH-1 trial, 63% of Hovilpri patients achieved complete lesion healing by day 28 versus 34% on investigator's-choice treatment.
key_facts.excerpt: By Day 28, 63% of HOVILPRI-treated participants achieved complete lesion healing compared with 34% of participants receiving Investigator's Choice treatment, corresponding to an adjusted treatment difference of 28.4%

key_facts.fact: The drug held Fast Track and Breakthrough Therapy designations and Priority Review, and is expected to be available in the U.S. before the end of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Pritelivir was granted Fast Track designation by the FDA along with Breakthrough Therapy designation and the New Drug Application received Priority Review... HOVILPRI is expected to be available in the United States before the end of 2026.

stories.headline: SpaceX CRS-35 launches the final pair of new solar arrays for the ISS

key_facts.fact: A Falcon 9 launched Cargo Dragon on NASA's CRS-35 mission from Cape Canaveral at 6:33 a.m. EDT on October 13, carrying more than 6,300 pounds of science and supplies.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket roared away from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station at 6:33 a.m. EDT (1033 UTC)... carrying more than 6,300 pounds of science and supplies

key_facts.fact: Dragon's trunk carries the fourth and final pair of Redwire-built Roll-Out Solar Arrays for the ISS, each providing more than 20 kW for over 10 years.
key_facts.excerpt: Built by Redwire Space, these were the fourth and final pair of ROSAs bound for the space station. Each are capable of providing more than 20 kW of power for more than 10 years.

key_facts.fact: NASA described the cargo as including the final set of International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Arrays; Dragon is due to stay about a month and splash down off California in mid-November.
key_facts.excerpt: including the final set of International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Arrays, to the space station... The Dragon spacecraft is scheduled to remain at the space station until mid-November when it will depart the orbiting laboratory and return to Earth with time-critical research and cargo, splashing down off the coast of California.

key_facts.fact: Cargo includes hardware to manufacture artificial retinas in microgravity, 3D heart tissue models and brain organoids for neurodegenerative-disease research; Dragon docks to Harmony on October 15.
key_facts.excerpt: the Dragon spacecraft will deliver hardware to manufacture artificial retinas in microgravity to help restore vision on Earth and 3D heart tissues models... and brain organoids that could reveal treatment targets for neurodegenerative diseases

key_facts.fact: A version of the ROSA will help power NASA's Space Reactor 1 Freedom (SR-1 Freedom), launching in 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: A version of the ROSA will be used to help power NASA's Space Reactor 1 Freedom (SR-1 Freedom) when it launches in 2028.
